description: Reviewed baseline for CROCO_STATIC_EMPTY_CATCH_RUNTIME_BOUNDARY. New production empty catch blocks must be converted or added with package/file/reason and owner/expiration metadata.

entries.reason: Telemetry event delivery is best-effort and must not replace the cache invalidation outcome.
Telemetry error reporting is best-effort and must not replace the original adapter failure evidence.
Runtime inspector failure reporters are optional instrumentation and must not affect application behavior.
Analytics delivery is best-effort after onboarding state has already been persisted.
Best-effort test logger failure must not hide the original after-commit hook failure.
Startup logging is optional and must not prevent the GraphQL server from resolving a successful listen callback.
Dev inspector warning logging is best-effort and must not affect request handling.
Telemetry degraded header emission is best-effort because telemetry setup has already failed and request handling should continue.
Container diagnostics provider registration is optional; unavailable providers should not prevent default operational diagnostics.
Event bus diagnostics provider registration is optional; unavailable providers should not prevent default operational diagnostics.
